apps.name: PagePocket
apps.subtitle: Open local HTML files like real web apps.
apps.localizedDescription: PagePocket opens local HTML files, folders and ZIP bundles from the Files app, iCloud Drive or the share sheet, and serves them from a private loopback server so fetch(), ES modules, Web Workers, localStorage and IndexedDB all work. Paste HTML and run it instantly.

versions.localizedDescription:
Distribute via AltStore: IPA release workflow and source

- SharedInbox resolves the App Group from ALTAppGroups, since AltStore
  renames it per team; without this the Share Extension breaks.
- scripts/build-ipa.sh builds an ad-hoc signed IPA that keeps the App
  Group entitlement AltStore reads from the signature.
- Tagging v* publishes a GitHub Release and updates altstore/source.json.
